definition.name: Link one kernel and boot three isolated cases

steps.name: Check image boundaries and current native source projection
Install upstream compiler and isolated emulator prerequisites
steps.run:
sudo timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=30s 180s apt-get update
sudo timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=30s 900s apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends gcc make flex bison bc libelf-dev libssl-dev binutils qemu-system-x86 seabios

steps.name: Acquire exact official maintained source archive
Link candidate kernel and exercise actual constructor in isolated VM
Retain bounded image identities, observations and original failures
